lastCompletedStory.title: Dispatch runReviewPhaseFn from the sidecar poll loop on phase:review

nextStoryContext: RunSidecarLoopOptions now carries an optional runReviewPhaseFn?: () => void | Promise<void> (declared next to runShipPhaseFn, src/supervisor/loop.ts). runSidecarLoop dispatches it exactly when readLoopPhaseFn() returns 'review', in a branch placed right after the shipping branch and before the awaiting-operator branch (mutually exclusive with planning/shipping/awaiting-operator/idle via the phase enum, same as those siblings). The branch mirrors the shipping branch's contract, not the planning branch's: the injected closure owns its own phase->idle reset (no separate 'on done' callback), and the outer try/catch only catches + logs a 'review-phase-crash-outer' sidecar-exit event on throw, then sleeps+continues -- a throwing runReviewPhaseFn cannot crash the loop. When runReviewPhaseFn is absent, phase:review is silently ignored (falls through toward the idle path, zero behavior change for existing tests). Tests live in test/supervisor/loop.test.ts's new 'runSidecarLoop — review-phase dispatch (US-003, CAM-403)' describe block (not test/supervisor/sidecar-loop.test.ts, which holds the planning-branch equivalents) -- follow its style (readLoopPhaseFn returning a phase sequence, sleep throwing an ESCAPE symbol after N ticks) for any new phase-branch tests. Next up (US-004): wire the PRODUCTION runReviewPhaseFn closure in sidecar.ts (one makeReviewDispatch round wrapping the existing review-dispatch machinery used by the manual /cam-review path), analogous to makeProductionShipPhaseFn / makeProductionPlanPhaseFn. Only after US-004 lands is it safe to start US-005's cleanup (collapse the cam-review template, drop subagent-reviewer from the orch Task allowlist) -- the orchestrator-side /cam-review slash command and subagent-reviewer template remain load-bearing until the sidecar-side production dispatch exists end-to-end.
